title: Add explicit LAN bind option for local review
description: Purpose: allow an explicitly requested local Apricity review server to bind a validated host such as 0.0.0.0 while preserving 127.0.0.1 default. Allowed CLI/serve tests/docs only. Reject malformed host values; no automatic LAN exposure.
right_now_summary: Work is focused on adding a validated LAN bind option while keeping localhost as the default.
